simple.summary: חֶרֶשׂ (cheres) means a piece of pottery First listed occurrence: Ezek 23 34.

definitions.full: H2789. cheres חֶ֫רֶשׂ noun [masculine] earthenware, earthen vessel, sherd, potsherd , P and late (Late Hebrew חֶרֶס , Aramaic חֲרַס ) — absolute ׳ח Lev 6:21 9 t., חָ֑רֶשׂ Num 5:17 4 t.; plural construct חַרְשֵׂי Isa 45:9 ; suffix חֲרָשֶׂיהָ Ezek 23:34 . — 1 earthenware: ׳כְּלִיאח earthen vessel Jer 32:14 ; especially P Lev 6:21 ; 11:33 ; 14:5 , 50 ; 15:12 ; Num 5:17 ; without כְּלִי Prov 26:23 ; compare ח יוֺצֵר ׳בַּקְבֻּק Jer 19:1 ; ח ׳לְנִבְלֵי Lam 4:2 they are reckoned as earthen vessels , simile of sons of Zion; אֲדָמָה אֶתחַֿרְשֵׂי חֶרֶשׂ Isa 45:9 a potsherd (perhaps = earthen vessel , see Prov 26:23 above) among earthen potsherds (of men, over against ׳י their potter); simile of dryness Psa 22:16 . 2 a fragment of earthenware, sherd Isa 30:14 ; Ezek 23:34 ; ׳ח לְהִתְגָּרֵד Job 2:8 a sherd to scrape himself ; ח ׳חַדּוּדֵי 41:22 sharpest potsherds , figurative of sharp scales on belly of crocodile. חֲרֶשֶׂת see קִירחֲֿרֶשֶׂת .
